messages:
tanya_lee: Noticing a spike in SCIM deprovision failures starting ~11:06 UTC. Errors show OIDC issuer mismatch and KMS rewrap context errors. Some customers lost role bindings. Anyone near identity infra?

josh.wang: Paste an example error? HTTP code, IdP response, or our logs?

tanya_lee: Snippet from prod log: 
```
ERROR oidc.validate - token validation failed: issuer_mismatch expected=https://sso.redwood.example got=https://idp.cust.example
ERROR scim.handler - deprovision user=acme:U987 status=422 detail="external_id not found"
ERROR kms.client - Encrypt/Decrypt failed: envelope_context_mismatch target_key=projects/prod/keys/scim-service
```

sam_irving: Two parallel issues: IdP seems to have started using tenant-scoped issuer URLs (they added tenant subdomain) which breaks our static issuer assertions. Meanwhile KMS error indicates the scim service account key was rewrapped with a different context. Could be their automation plus our rekey job overlapped.

security-oncall: Was there an IdP announced change? I checked the vendor portal: they rolled out "tenanted-issuer" feature at 11:00 UTC and warned integrators to update metadata. Did we fetch new metadata automatically?

josh.wang: Our metadata refresher runs every 6h. We have a manual webhook handler but it was disabled for maintenance this morning. So we didn't pick up the new tenanted issuer. That would cause issuer_mismatch.

tanya_lee: That maps. For KMS: ops-bot shows a rewrap job executed at 11:04 UTC: `kms.rewrap --service=scim --new-context=tenant=acme` as part of a compliance key rotation. That would make existing encrypted external_id tokens un-decryptable until rewrapped or backfilled.

sam_irving: So deprovisions retried -> duplicates or 422s because external_id lookup fails. We should pause SCIM retrier and run a targeted rewrap/backfill. Also accept both global and tenanted issuer forms temporarily.

josh.wang: Short fix: enable relaxed issuer validation for up to 10m and manually trigger metadata fetch. I can open a quick change: https://git.internal/redwood/identity/commit/1a2b3c enable-issuer-fallback. Will canary in eu-west.

security-oncall: Confirming vendor roll-out was announced but some customers opted in early, so it's a mixed environment. This is configuration drift, not compromise. No legal escalation. We'll log in vuln triage notes that no key exfiltration observed.

ops-bot: Rewrap job completed for scim service at 11:12 UTC. Re-encryption summary: 1527 records rewrapped, 0 failures.

tanya_lee: Great. Next steps: 1) josh trigger metadata fetch and enable fallback 2) ops run `scim-backfill --from=2026-03-21T11:00Z --service=scim` to restore external_id artifacts 3) disable retrier temporarily to avoid duplicate deprovisions 4) CS notify 10 affected customers.

sam_irving: I'll open tickets: IDENTITY-784 (issuer fallback), IDENTITY-785 (scim retrier circuit-breaker), IDENTITY-786 (kms rewrap monitoring). Also suggest we add a check in pre-rotate job to pause SCIM jobs if rewrap is in progress.

josh.wang: Canary deployed in eu-west, metrics look stable. Rolling to us-west in 3m.

ops-bot: Backfill job started 11:18 UTC, ETA ~9m. Progress updates will follow.

security-oncall: Closing vuln triage for now; file open for postmortem if >50 users or >30m impact. Current impact estimate: 12 users and intermittent deprovs.

tanya_lee: Once backfill completes we'll run an audit: `select count(*) from rbac_audit where event='deprov' and created_at > '2026-03-21T11:00'` and compare to known-good snapshot. Postmortem will capture root cause: vendor tenanted issuer rollout + our disabled metadata webhook + overlapping KMS rewrap. Proposed remediations: webhook health alerting, pre-rotate quiesce, issuer-flexible validation with stricter audit logs.

josh.wang: I'll own the postmortem and link artifacts. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
